propositions: Changing ticket_type from bug to task silently reuses a stored PASS verdict computed under bug exemptions, incorrectly replaying a verdict invalid under the current type's criteria
material_fingerprint excludes ticket_type from its hash basis, so type changes alone do not invalidate the fingerprint and stored attestations remain eligible for reuse
Both idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse paths gate reuse on material_fingerprint and verified_sha but never compare the stored ticket_type against the current context type
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type, enabling type comparison in reuse paths without schema changes

A type mismatch between stored and current context must return None to force a full re-review under the correct criteria, while sidecars with absent or empty type must still reuse to preserve existing certifications
